aboutPage.heroTitle: A Story That Started with Fire
aboutPage.heroSubtitle: From the heart of Iran to Doha, a flavor passed down through generations
aboutPage.storyP1: Kabab Dagh Nan Dagh was born in 2018 from a simple dream: to bring authentic Iranian flavor to Qatar. Every skewer, every fresh bread, every stew is the result of recipes passed down through Iranian families for generations.
aboutPage.storyP2: Today in the heart of Doha, we combine Iranian hospitality with unmatched quality, making every meal a memory.

aboutPage.value2Desc: True to traditional Iranian flavors, without shortcuts

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to your common questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about our restaurant, menu, and services
faq.a1: Yes, all our food is prepared according to Islamic law using high-quality meat. We respect our customers' health and beliefs.
faq.q2: Is online ordering and home delivery available?
faq.a2: Yes, you can order through our website, food delivery apps, or by phone. Delivery follows strict health protocols.
faq.q3: Is the menu suitable for children and special diets?
faq.a3: We offer a special kids' menu along with vegetarian and dietary options. Please inform our team of any special dietary needs.
faq.q4: Does the restaurant have a private space for parties and gatherings?
faq.a4: Yes, we have private and semi-private halls of various sizes for family celebrations, friendly gatherings, and corporate events.
faq.q5: What are the restaurant's opening hours?
faq.a5: The restaurant is open daily from 8 AM to 2 AM. Hours may change during holidays and special occasions, announced on social media.

contact.formDesc: Please fill in your details carefully so we can process your order or message quickly.

hours1.a: We are open every day from 8 AM to 2 AM.

hours2.a: Salwa Road, Al Rayyan, Doha, Qatar.

hours3.a: Yes, we are open on most public holidays.

menu1.a: Yes, we offer vegetarian appetizers like hummus, Shirazi salad, and yogurt with cucumber.

menu2.a: Most dishes are moderately spiced. For spicy dishes, try the spicy kofta or spicy chicken.

menu3.q: What languages is the menu available in?
menu3.a: Our menu is available in Persian, Arabic, and English.

menu4.a: Yes, you can add special notes when ordering.

order1.q: How do I place an order?
order1.a: Add items to your cart from the menu page, then complete the checkout steps.

order2.a: Delivery within Doha is 10 QAR. Outside Doha is calculated based on distance.

order3.a: Usually 30 to 60 minutes depending on distance and order.

order4.q: Can I pick up from the restaurant?
order4.a: Yes, choose pickup when checking out.

order5.q: How do I track my order?
order5.a: After ordering, you'll receive a confirmation message via WhatsApp. You can also call us.

reservation1.q: How do I book a table?
reservation1.a: Call the restaurant directly or send a reservation request via WhatsApp.

reservation2.a: Yes, table reservations are completely free.

reservation3.q: For how many people can I book?
reservation3.a: We welcome small and large groups of up to 20 people.

payment1.a: Cash, card in person, or online (bank transfer) are available.

payment2.a: Yes, in addition to on-site payment, online payment (bank transfer) is also available.

payment3.q: Is tax added to the prices?
payment3.a: No, menu prices are final with no additional tax.

payment4.a: There is no minimum, but orders over 50 QAR get free delivery.
